trap.label: phrasal verb
trap.wrong: She took the paper over of her father.
trap.right: She took over the paper from her father.
trap.why: O brasileiro tenta usar preposição de “assumir de”. Em inglês: take over + objeto (from alguém).

mcq.q: I’ll take over **___** you at noon.

mcq.why: Com pronome, ele fica no meio.

fix.why: Pronome vai entre verbo e partícula.

fix.wrong: I will take over of you.
fix.right: I will take over from you.

rewrite.prompt: Troque o objeto pelo pronome it: “I’ll take over the story.”

rewrite.answer: He didn’t take over the job.
